show_raw_pointcloud: create a trimesh scene to display a 3D point cloud with colors and configurable point size
pts3d_to_trimesh: build a trimesh mesh from an image and 3D points with optional validity mask for filtering
cat_meshes: create a single combined mesh by concatenating multiple trimesh mesh dictionaries with adjusted face indices
SceneViz_add_pointcloud: build a SceneViz instance and add a masked 3D point cloud with vertex colors to the scene
segment_sky: create a boolean mask to segment sky regions from an image using HSV color thresholds and connected components
